risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, but it highlights material credit stress, including $271 million of non-performing assets, elevated real estate exposures, and a 7% loan contraction. Earnings improvement was substantially driven by a $39.9 million reduction in loan-loss provision and included one-time items, while net interest margin declined materially. Capital and liquidity trends are presented positively, though asset mix shifts toward securities and dependence on market conditions introduce ongoing risk.
